page.overview:
What is Drifblim?

Drifblim is a hot air balloon-like Pokémon that is primarily purple, with the bottom part of its body being a lighter shade, separated by semicircle-like motifs. It has a cloud on its head, and like Drifloon, it has an X on its body, only much bigger, and its eyes are now red. It appears to have four narrow arms that extend diagonally and are yellow at the end. Its rear has a red appendage.

Drifblim floats anywhere the air current takes them, but groups of children have been known to disappear suddenly when spotted. It is more active at night than in the day. They appear to be a docile species in the wild, while they also don't seem to eat at all. Drifblim may also be known as the child napper or bombardier airship.

Drifblim are strong enough to carry/transport/take people and Pokémon around to nowhere able to be seen. It can inflate and deflate at will.

Drifblim evolves from Drifloon starting at level 28.
